note: The RPM state machine (off/starting/running/stopping, PROP/JET profiles, voiceFor()) ported exactly. Audio realized with Unity idioms: two looping AudioSources (idle/run) sharing one AudioLowPassFilter (the JS's muffleFilter) on one GameObject; wind noise and the oscillator fallback each get their OWN GameObject so Unity's per-GameObject filter semantics don't cross-contaminate them (a real topology risk identified and fixed during this port -- see the class's Start() comments); the 3-sawtooth fallback is live DSP via OnAudioFilterRead (EngineFallbackOscillator) since its frequency varies continuously with RPM, unlike the baked one-shots in AudioFx.cs. Every WebAudio setTargetAtTime(...) becomes a per-frame one-pole exponential approach computed in Update(dt), with the SAME tau values the JS used.
verified: EngineProbe + tools/_probe_sound.mjs -- RPM state machine for prop/jet/jet-afterburner profiles, 6 checkpoints each. Covers ignite->starting->running only: shutdown() short-circuits to state='off' without a live AudioContext in the JS itself, so the stopping decay curve cannot be observed from plain node (documented in both probe scripts) and was reviewed by hand instead.
